featuresSection.description: Tools that already live in the student workspace — nothing invented for the landing page.
featuresSection.feature1Desc: Chat with the assistant to draft, improve, save a resume, and export PDF.

featuresSection.feature6Desc: UI and AI replies in Kazakh, Russian, and English.

aboutPage.title: About QalaJob AI
aboutPage.subtitle: An AI platform connecting students with internships, remote work, and entry-level vacancies across Kazakhstan.
aboutPage.missionDesc: We believe every student deserves access to real career opportunities. QalaJob AI helps find internships, freelance, and first jobs through intelligent vacancy and profile matching.
aboutPage.whyDesc: We combine local market knowledge with automated matching so students find relevant opportunities faster and employers find suitable candidates.
aboutPage.reason1Desc: We take into account the language, curriculum, and specifics of the Kazakhstan market.
aboutPage.reason2Desc: Recommendations based on skills, experience, and career goals.
aboutPage.reason3Desc: Guidance, resume help, and curated opportunity selection.
aboutPage.feature1Desc: Intelligent vacancy recommendations based on skills and profile.
aboutPage.feature2Desc: Search for internships, remote and entry-level positions.
aboutPage.feature3Desc: Quick hiring of talented students using AI.
aboutPage.step1Desc: Register and fill out your profile.
aboutPage.step2Desc: The model analyzes your skills and interests.
aboutPage.step3Desc: Submit applications and connect with employers.
aboutPage.founderDesc: Rashitov Nurzhigit & Adil Madi founded QalaJob to bridge the gap between education and work. Our team brings together AI engineers, career mentors, and employer partners.
aboutPage.ctaDesc: Join QalaJob AI and find suitable opportunities.
